prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE original finished landscape painting, wide 16:9 composition, for an atmospheric window into Lysandria in The Chronicle. A serene sunlit Mediterranean and Middle Eastern fantasy island, softly hand-painted animation-background aesthetic: luminous chalk-white limestone, weathered timber and aged brass, lush green foliage, summer cobalt-blue sky with big soft white clouds, turquoise sea. View from a quiet sea-facing pottery terrace: simple workbench near the left edge with a few handmade bowls and two blue-banded jugs, a folded cloth and quiet traces of ordinary craft; low carved stone wall and worn brass-and-wood railing descend diagonally toward a sheltered inlet; leafy vines and a cypress frame the edges. Across the bay on the SAME island, EXACTLY TWO immense distinct mountain peaks rise beyond layered pale coastal terraces, separated by a low saddle. Both peaks clearly visible in the central middle distance and uncut by the image edge; do not add a third tall peak or connect island to a mainland. Balance intimate foreground craft and grand distant terrain. Eye level slightly low, plentiful sky in upper third; bright warm afternoon light, soft brushwork, delicate painterly textures, gentle shadow, quiet air. An ORIGINAL composition from this textual brief, not a reconstruction of any video frame. No people, faces, readable writing, signage, logos, watermark, border, futuristic machinery, dark grim fantasy, photorealism, glowing magic, monumental palace or battle. This is a visual interpretation of an unspecified terrace, not a new canonical named site. Keep the central view uncluttered. Static painting only; the website will supply separately controllable subtle atmospheric motion.
